headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and holding — 41.9/100; Luzon Strait is the lead driver, -23% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **41.9/100** (**high**), flat week-over-week. 3 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.

**374** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Bosporus Strait** is running **31% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$88.24/bbl** (-4.82% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
